invariants.rationale: Captures the possibility that ellipsis can be null, as indicated by the @Null annotation.
Checks that if ellipsis is not null, it may also be a non-empty string (likely to display some ellipsis marker).
Guards the call to length() with a null check; length() is always non-negative.
If ellipsis is not null, its trimmed value may be expected not to be empty for visual usage.
